name: Andreas Hofer
beschreibung: The Hotel Andreas Hofer is centrally situated in Kufstein, just a few minutes' walk from the train station and the fortress. Rooms are furnished with local wood and provide picturesque views of either the old town or the Inn Valley. The on-site restaurant serves authentic regional specialities alongside international classics. A dedicated wellness area complete with a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation room is available to guests. Several modern conference rooms are well suited for business meetings and private celebrations. The hotel also features an underground garage with limited parking spaces. Its prime setting allows guests to reach the town centre and nearby hiking routes easily on foot.
